requirements.description: Pricing-calculation formula: Total weighted cost = (0.55 × item 1 cost + 0.35 × item 2 cost + 0.10 × item 3 cost). Item 1: Cohort Program Development & Design and Program Delivery (25 people, 3 full days (8 hr. per day), 3 modules) – weight 0.55. Item 2: Cohort Program Development & Design and Program Delivery (25 people, 3 1/2 days (4 hrs. per day), 3 modules) – weight 0.35. Item 3: Travel Expenses (includes round-trip airfare to Calgary (economy class), three (3) nights' accommodation, meals, and other related travel costs) – weight 0.10.
For item 1 & 2 above The City will require a cost breakdown form the highest rated negotiations proponent

The Consultant shall provide post-facilitation support per participant within each Cohort. Post-facilitation support may include, but is not limited to: addressing participant questions/or availability to answer questions from participants, assess assignments that may be required for the class. For the purposes of the Pricing Form; Pricing shall be based on three (3) hours of post-facilitation support per participant within each Cohort.
Proponents must be registered in Alberta Registries or registered in another jurisdiction and subject to the Business Corporations Act to legally carry on business in Alberta.
Pricing must be provided in lump sum format for each cohort using the sample scenarios provided in the Excel spreadsheet.

Proponents must provide pricing based only on the requirements and scenarios outlined in the pricing form; the solicitation is limited to the scope of services as defined in the RFP and does not include additional services such as coaching or psychometric assessments.
Travel costs must be captured within the Price Form and are incorporated into the overall pricing formula used for evaluation and scoring.

Account Manager responsibilities are to act primarily as a key contact for project/account management and oversight. The City is open to proponents assigning a separate leadership/L&D subject matter expert responsible for program design.
Maximum submission length is 20 pages as stated in clause 2.3 Proposal Format of the RFP.

Personnel resumes included in appendices will not be considered in the number of pages and may be included as an Appendix to the section on Team Experience and Qualifications; they will be evaluated as part of Evaluation Criteria 2, subsection 2.2 – Other Personnel.

Proponents must submit proposals with a maximum submission length of 20 pages (excluding appendices such as personnel resumes and the executive summary which is considered equivalent to a cover letter). Submissions must be made via SAP Ariba; a Zip folder is acceptable to accommodate the completed Excel Pricing Form (Appendix D). Either separate submission or combined submission of the Excel Pricing Form and Proposal Content is acceptable.

Cohort sessions are expected to be delivered as consecutive full-day sessions (e.g., three full days in sequence). The baseline cohort duration of approximately three days applies consistently across all six leadership levels (Personal Leadership through Leading Supervisors/Managers).

The City will be reviewing its tracking system in 2028 and does not require integration with the existing LMS for tracking participation and learning progress at this time. The City is open to proponents using the vendor platform to deploy content, either by itself or in tandem with the City's LMS.

The City's preferred method is a balanced effort of modalities that include classroom, online, practice and asynchronous e-learning materials. The City's LMS system is Cornerstone. The City is open to suggestions and does not have preferences regarding allocation of learning methods, modalities, or program durations by level/role; it depends on the learning needs assessment.

Proponents must provide three (3) examples where their firm has delivered services of comparable scale, scope, or relevance. The specific scale of the proposed City project and anticipated volume of cohorts is provided in Addendum 2 response to Question 19.

Urgent inquiries are those that may impact the Supplier's ability to meet a scheduled service delivery; the City requires acknowledgement within response timeframes specified in Section 6.3 so that any potential risks, delays, or corrective actions can be addressed promptly. Non-urgent inquiries are requests, questions, or administrative matters that do not require immediate action and do not pose a risk to scheduled service delivery.

a) As per Ariba instructions, a Zip folder is acceptable. b) Either is acceptable. The RFP requires completion of the Excel Pricing Form (Appendix D), and the Proposal Content for Rated Criteria may be submitted together or separately.
The executive summary is considered equivalent to a cover letter and does not count toward the page limit. Submission must maintain the twenty (20) page limit for proposal content.

A module refers to a unit of training content delivered during the session. In Scenario 1, each module is delivered within an 8-hour (full-day) session, and in Scenario 2, each module is delivered within a 4-hour (half-day) session. Based on the sample scenarios provided, Scenario 1 consists of three modules delivered over three full days, while Scenario 2 consists of three modules delivered over three half-days.
Cohorts are to be delivered as consecutive full-day sessions. Consecutive full-day sessions are required for cohort delivery.

Urgent inquiries are those that may impact the Supplier's ability to meet a scheduled service delivery. In these situations, the City requires acknowledgement within the response timeframes specified in Section 6.3 so that any potential risks, delays, or corrective actions can be addressed promptly. Non-urgent inquiries are requests, questions, or administrative matters that do not require immediate action and do not pose a risk to scheduled service delivery.
Appendix D – Pricing Form Instructions: Instruction #1: Delete hourly rate and replace it with price.

The Personal Leadership Program target audience are Individual Contributors who are not in supervisory roles/do not have direct reports and who have not taken the Emerging Leaders Program. PLP participants will self-enroll for the program to further develop their interpersonal and informal leadership skills. Emerging Leaders are those who have been identified as future leaders, and who may take up a supervisory role within a year of taking the program.
Expected time duration of one cohort: approx. three days for one cohort

Pricing is to be provided for one (1) sample cohort only, as per Appendix B: Deliverables. Lump Sum (LS) price for one (1) sample cohort under Item 1. Lump Sum (LS) price for one (1) sample cohort under Item 2. If applicable, a fixed travel expense fee for one (1) person under Item 3. Annual pricing, pricing for all six (6) leadership levels, pricing for multiple cohorts, and pricing for the total value of the contract term are NOT being asked for.
Pricing calculation formula: Total weighted cost = (0.55 × Item 1 cost + 0.35 × Item 2 cost + 0.10 × Item 3 cost). Item 1 weighted at 55%, Item 2 weighted at 35%, Item 3 weighted at 10%.
For the purposes of the Pricing Form; Pricing shall be based on three (3) hours of post-facilitation support per participant within One (1) cohort. 25 participants X 3 hours = 75 hours
For Item 1 & 2, The City will require a cost breakdown form the Highest Rated Negotiations proponent.
Proponent must acknowledge receipt, examination, and understanding of the RFP and all Addenda as part of the RFP.

requirements.description: Proponents must be a registered supplier in the SAP ARIBA Business Network portal to submit a proposal. Proposals must be submitted electronically on SAP ARIBA on or before the Submission Deadline. To submit a proposal, a proponent must navigate to the Event Contents page and use the "Attach a File" link in the "RFX Information and Supplier Submission" section to include their submission response and then use the "Submit Entire Response" button to complete submission of the Proposal. The submission receipt provided electronically by SAP ARIBA upon submission of a Proposal will be the date and time of submission for the purpose of determining whether a Proposal is submitted on or before the Submission Deadline. Proposals that do not comply with the above instructions will not be considered.

requirements.description: Service Category: Personal Leadership (People Capabilities); Emerging Leaders (People Capabilities); Foundational Leadership: Office - new leader/new to City 1–5 years' experience; Front-Line Leaders: Field - new leader/new to City 1–5 years' experience; Mid-to Senior-Level Leaders: have direct reports 5+ yrs experience leading projects; Leading supervisors and leading managers. The Consultant shall provide leadership learning and development consulting services aligned with the City's Learning and Development Strategy for the listed Leadership Development Cohorts.
requirements.source_doc: S-PT-073-RFP with Price - V2.5_Design and Delivery Services for Leadership Learning and Development_June 12.docx

requirements.description: Pricing Form requirement: Complete the pricing table by providing proposed hourly rates. All prices must be flat rate only as ranges will not be considered. The proposed rates must be inclusive of all labour costs, all insurance costs, and all material costs of photocopying, long-distance telephone services or conference calls, fax transmissions, any postage or courier costs. Any additional costs must be approved in writing by The City prior to submission of any invoices for payment of them. Proponent must keep all proposed unit prices firm for a period of two (2) years following the official award. Upon renewal, any price adjustment related to inflation may be negotiated, subject to City approval, and must be based on actual and relevant costs associated with delivering the services and reflective of local and national economic conditions. All proposed pricing must be in Canadian currency and exclusive of GST.
requirements.source_doc: S-PT-073-RFP with Price - V2.5_Design and Delivery Services for Leadership Learning and Development_June 12.docx

requirements.description: Provide three (3) examples from the past five (5) years (other than The City) where your firm delivered services of comparable scale, scope, or relevance to the requirements of this RFP. (10% for each example) At a minimum each example should provide: Strong emphasis on Cohort learning design. An overview of the services provided, including program objectives, content areas, delivery methods, duration, and level of customization, monetary value, program scale. Key outcomes, results, or demonstrated benefits achieved for the client. Challenges or issues that arose during design/delivery and how they were mitigated.

Describe applicable skill sets, time commitment and availability to meet, response times, credentials, and demonstrated experience and expertise in similar scopes of work.

requirements.description: 2.2 Other Personnel (10%): Provide an organizational chart of the team members that will be available to provide services to The City including: Roles and responsibilities of the team as it relates to the RFP scope of work. Outline team members involved (if possible) in specific projects for examples provided. Bios/resumes for each team member including relevant credentials and experience related to scope of work iterated in this RFP. How team members will be organized and deployed to complete service requests that arise, with reference to applicable skill sets, credentials, and demonstrated experience.

requirements.description: 3.1 Understanding of the Services: Describe your firm's methodology and approach to delivering on this RFP. Details should include: Methods and approach to delivering design services. Process to handle a City request once received. Consultation/collaborative approaches used to meet the request. Delivery modes and methods. Goals and objectives – ability to show program mandate - what does success look like. Processes and practices for managing the relationship with The City to ensure successful delivery, including: Issues resolution/escalation measures, quality assurance process, response times to City requests for urgent matters. Ability to deliver services/provide coverage if principal is not available or on demand.
